Without it, "How being an anointed pilot-prophet..." in the draft is left as a fragment — grammatically it is a bare noun clause ("How being...") that has no main verb governing it and no antecedent structure. In the source it is the object of "listen as you listen, while some one of you reads *me* [the lesson of] how being an anointed pilot-prophet...". Stripped of its governing clause, it now simply hangs. A reader genuinely cannot tell whether "How" is the beginning of a question, an exclamation, or a dependent clause whose matrix clause was cut.
